query: 每个工厂实际产量最高的产品分别是什么？
sql:
SELECT factory_name, product_name, actual_quantity
FROM (
  SELECT w.factory_name,
         pd.product_name,
         SUM(p.actual_quantity) AS actual_quantity,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY w.factory_name
           ORDER BY SUM(p.actual_quantity) DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM table_production_record p
  JOIN table_workshop w ON p.workshop_id = w.workshop_id
  JOIN table_product pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id
  GROUP BY w.factory_name, pd.product_name
) t
WHERE rn = 1

       SUM(p.qualified_quantity) / SUM(p.actual_quantity) AS qualified_rate
